summary: Backend-only testing for Brevo connection-check integration. Created /app/backend/tests/test_brevo_check.py (pytest) covering: (1) 401 without auth, (2) safe response with empty BREVO_API_KEY, (3) no leakage of API key or Brevo account payload, (4) endpoint contract only exposes {configured, valid, status, message}, (5) /api/auth/login regression, (6) invalid session token rejected. All 4 tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint /api/integrations/brevo/check correctly reads BREVO_API_KEY from env, does NOT persist it, does NOT return it, and returns only safe fields. With empty key it short-circuits BEFORE any HTTP call to Brevo — verified by code review (only /v3/account is referenced; /v3/smtp/email is never called anywhere in backend).
Superadmin guard via Depends(require_superadmin) is applied. Anonymous returns 401 as required.
Suggestion (non-blocking): consider a small HEAD/timeout retry policy and structured logging (without key) for observability, but current implementation is safe and correct for connection-only phase.
context_for_next_testing_agent: When BREVO_API_KEY is later populated in prod Secrets, re-run test_brevo_check.py and add scenarios for status 200/401/403/429 responses from Brevo (mock via httpx respx or hit real endpoint with a test key). Ensure the endpoint still never returns key or account payload fields (companyName, plan, credits, firstName, lastName, address).
